premises.text: Many smartphone users lack internet access, which can be life-critical and blocks social and economic growth; mega-app and village-internet efforts are not seen as scalable soon
premises.evidence_span: 66% of the world has a smartphone in their hands, but 53% of the population does not have access to internet

premises.text: An SDK lets existing apps work offline by connecting phones via Bluetooth mesh networks with smart routing that avoids flood, stale messages, and battery drain
premises.evidence_span: Ridgefire is an SDK that apps integrate onto their own code so they can work offline

premises.text: Differentiation includes Android-to-iOS integration, encryption, and patents
premises.evidence_span: We are the only ones in the market with Android to iOS integration

premises.text: B2B sells to developers with user density (messaging, rideshare, emergency broadcast) rather than building a consumer mega-app
premises.evidence_span: we're working on a B2B model. We cater to developers that already have this user density

premises.text: Pricing charges on monthly active users who use the app thanks to the offline technology
premises.evidence_span: We charge based on monthly active users that use your app thanks to our technology each month

value.text: People and apps stay connected without internet, improving and saving lives in critical moments
value.evidence_span: versatile products that improve and save people's lives

secondary_value.text: Developers open new markets and revenue by being present in high-need offline moments
secondary_value.evidence_span: You open up new markets. You open and you blow up existing ones. So that translates into revenue

causal_links.evidence_span: It can be the difference between life and death
connects phones directly using their Bluetooth antennas
By being there in the moments where people really, really need an app

notes: Mesh hop, range, flood/battery algorithm folded into one SDK mechanism (feature cascade). Encryption/patents kept as IP detail attached to that mechanism per v1.3.1. Use-case list (WhatsApp/Uber/broadcast) treated as applications of the same SDK, not separate premises. Raise and user-count traction excluded. Anti-template note: need, technology, and B2B monetization are separately revisable in the transcript. Truncated mid-vision sentence.
